## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: After the configured number of identical resolutions of a gate kind under...

The system SHALL ensure that after the configured number of identical resolutions of a gate kind under matching features, a promotion card is raised once and not raised again while it is pending.

#### Scenario: After the configured number of identical resolutions of a gate kind under...

WHEN `promote-repeated-gate-resolutions-to-auto-policy-rules` is implemented
THEN After the configured number of identical resolutions of a gate kind under matching features, a promotion card is raised once and not raised again while it is pending.

### Requirement: After the promotion is approved, the next matching gate resolves as tier...

The system SHALL ensure that after the promotion is approved, the next matching gate resolves as tier auto with the rule ID recorded in loop-state and the dispatch result.

#### Scenario: After the promotion is approved, the next matching gate resolves as tier...

WHEN `promote-repeated-gate-resolutions-to-auto-policy-rules` is implemented
THEN After the promotion is approved, the next matching gate resolves as tier auto with the rule ID recorded in loop-state and the dispatch result.

### Requirement: Approved rules are stored as decision-point playbook entries, and a rejected...

The system SHALL ensure that approved rules are stored as decision-point playbook entries, and a rejected promotion raises no further card for that pattern until new resolutions accumulate.

#### Scenario: Approved rules are stored as decision-point playbook entries, and a rejected...

WHEN `promote-repeated-gate-resolutions-to-auto-policy-rules` is implemented
THEN Approved rules are stored as decision-point playbook entries, and a rejected promotion raises no further card for that pattern until new resolutions accumulate.
